headline: Three tankers hit Tuesday in Hormuz: maritime agency
summary: A crude oil tanker and two other vessels were each struck by an unknown projectile on Tuesday in the Strait of Hormuz, according to the UK Maritime Trade Operations agency. The strait is a key route for Gulf crude.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne crude oil, so attacks there quickly affect oil prices and shipping costs.
why_moved: Three vessels were struck in the strait, a key oil route, raising supply-disruption risk. The input does not give price figures.
